title: 3D Phylogenetic Tree with Undo/Redo
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that renders an interactive 3D phylogenetic tree visualization with full undo/redo support.

## Scene Setup
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 5, 20), looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light at (10, 15, 10) with intensity 0.8.
- Background color: #0a0a1a (dark navy).
- Add OrbitControls for camera rotation/zoom.

## Phylogenetic Tree Structure
- Build a hardcoded phylogenetic tree with exactly 5 species as leaf nodes: 'Species_A', 'Species_B', 'Species_C', 'Species_D', 'Species_E'.
- Internal nodes: 'Ancestor_AB' (parent of A,B), 'Ancestor_CDE' (parent of C,D,E via intermediate 'Ancestor_DE' parent of D,E), and 'Root' (parent of Ancestor_AB and Ancestor_CDE). Total 9 nodes.
- Render each node as a sphere (radius 0.3). Leaf nodes are green (#00cc66), internal nodes are orange (#ff8833), root is red (#ff3333).
- Connect parent-child nodes with cylindrical branches (radius 0.05, white color).
- Layout the tree in 3D: Root at (0,6,0). Ancestor_AB at (-4,4,0), Ancestor_CDE at (4,4,0). Species_A at (-6,0,0), Species_B at (-2,0,0). Ancestor_DE at (5,2,0). Species_C at (2,0,0), Species_D at (4,0,-2), Species_E at (6,0,2).
- Add text labels (using sprite-based labels or HTML overlay divs) showing each node's name below/beside each sphere.

## Node Selection & Editing
- Implement raycasting: clicking on a node sphere selects it (highlight with emissive yellow glow, emissive=0x444400). Only one node selected at a time.
- When a node is selected, show an info panel (DOM div, id='info-panel') on the right side showing: node name, node type (leaf/internal/root), position (x,y,z), and a color picker input (id='color-picker') to change that node's color.
- Changing a node's color via the color picker is an undoable action.

## Branch Collapse/Expand
- When an internal node (non-leaf) is selected, show a 'Toggle Collapse' button (id='btn-collapse') in the info panel.
- Collapsing hides all descendant nodes and branches, and replaces them with a single triangle/cone mesh at the internal node position pointing downward. The internal node sphere remains visible.
- Expanding reverses this. Both operations are undoable.
- Track collapsed state per internal node.

## Undo/Redo System
- Maintain an undo stack and redo stack of actions.
- Supported undoable actions: (1) color change, (2) collapse/expand toggle, (3) node position drag (see below).
- Add two DOM buttons: 'Undo' (id='btn-undo') and 'Redo' (id='btn-redo') at the top-left.
- Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+Z = undo, Ctrl+Y = redo.
- Disable buttons when respective stacks are empty.

## Node Dragging
- When a node is selected, pressing 'M' key enters move mode. In move mode, mouse movement on the XY plane repositions the selected node (and updates connected branches in real-time).
- Clicking again confirms the move. This is an undoable action that records old and new positions.
- Branches (cylinders) must update to connect to new positions.

## HUD / UI
- Top-left: Undo/Redo buttons with counts showing stack sizes, e.g., 'Undo (3)' and 'Redo (1)'.
- Top-center: Title 'Phylogenetic Tree 3D' in white text.
- Bottom-left: Status text (id='status-text') showing current mode: 'Mode: Select', 'Mode: Move', etc.
- Bottom-right: Node count display (id='node-count') showing 'Visible: X / Total: 9'.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
- totalNodes: 9 (always)
- visibleNodes: number of currently visible node spheres
- selectedNode: name string of selected node or null
- undoStackSize: number
- redoStackSize: number
- mode: 'select' | 'move'
- collapsedNodes: array of internal node names that are currently collapsed, e.g. ['Ancestor_CDE']
- nodePositions: object mapping node names to {x, y, z} with values rounded to 1 decimal
- nodeColors: object mapping node names to hex color strings like '#00cc66'
- branchCount: number of visible branch cylinders
- cameraDistance: distance from camera to origin, rounded to 1 decimal
- lastAction: string describing last undoable action performed, e.g. 'color_change', 'collapse', 'expand', 'move', or null initially
physics_constraints: No physics simulation. Branches must always correctly connect parent to child node positions (endpoints within 0.1 units of node centers). Node positions must be finite (no NaN/Infinity). Collapse/expand must correctly hide/show all descendants. Undo/redo must perfectly restore previous states.
